chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Harith ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man Sahib al-Taq, from Burayd al-'Ijli, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام: concerning
A man who ruptured a jāriyah — meaning his wife — and caused ifḍāʾ to her; he عليه السلام said: “The diyah is upon him if he had intercourse with her before she reached nine years.”

He عليه السلام said: “Then if he keeps her and does not divorce her, there is nothing upon him; and if he had intercourse with her when she was nine years old, then there is nothing upon him; if he wishes, he may keep her, and if he wishes, he may divorce her.”

key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a young female; here, referring to his wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man causes ifḍāʾ to his wife before she reaches nine years of age?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury caused to a wife through intercourse. It states that diyah is due if such injury occurred before she reached nine years of age, while no liability is stated in the cases mentioned thereafter. The report belongs to the jurisprudential discussion of bodily injuries and their legal consequences.
